answer: Make every identity tend a unique storage shard for the full epoch: the network hands each agent a distinct chunk of data to hold and prove at random intervals, like an anchor plot in a shared orchard. One honest agent keeps one small garden plot and answers its proofs cheaply. A farm minting thousands must provision real, distinct storage for every fake and answer every proof on time; dropped shards forfeit that identity's reward, so scale turns into a warehouse bill that outruns any payout.
